scope: Signed 0.2.1 -> 0.3.0 Windows update could not open the migrated workspace
mode: SQLite installed-copy upgrade; Windows 2022 CI and the emulated Windows flush on macOS
commands: env -u OPENDIALER_TEST_POSTGRES_URL uv run pytest services/backend/tests/test_installed_copy_migration.py -q -k writable
CI job backend-windows-storage (windows-2022): upgrade, migration, lock and journal suites

evidence_runs.windows_ci_red: 39669580659 (commit 2c92244): 12 failed, 106 passed, 3 skipped; 11 upgrade/migration cases EBADF or masked by it, 1 POSIX-mode assertion
evidence_runs.installed_store_after_failure: stage, candidate and retained sanitized copy present; original store unpublished
evidence_runs.windows_ci_green: 39670960937 (commit e2a9c8a): 118 passed, 3 skipped (the POSIX stand-in regression and two pending-receipt checks)

root_cause: migrate.prepare_database flushed the retained sanitized copy with os.fsync on a read-only handle; Windows os.fsync is _commit/FlushFileBuffers, which requires write access (EBADF). POSIX accepts it.
repair: Flush through an O_RDWR handle (b1b5307). The consent-journal permission-bit check applies only where POSIX modes exist.
known_limitations: The repaired Windows update needs a new signed package (0.3.1) and its own installed-update receipt.
0.3.0 was public 2026-10-21T19:34Z to 20:31Z, then marked prerelease so releases/latest returned to 0.2.1.
